ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across ~85% of the visible surface with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered as discrete focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark substrate (low-intensity pixels) across the central and proximal lobe regions. High-intensity geometric blobs are concentrated at the distal tips (outer extremities). Discrete white circular spots are distributed non-uniformly throughout the dark field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal vertex angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-20 pixels visible along the continuous boundary from the central notch to the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex upward trajectory sweeping from the central notch toward the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense white pixel clusters at both distal tips; sparse distribution of individual high-contrast circular spots (potential barnacle attachment sites) across the central lobe area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, light-colored linear marks and one distinct curved J-shaped marking on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular surface texture localized at the distal extremities of both lobes.
